mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport Authority / Notary Public in country of origin

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory PEP screening against international and domestic databases; full-scope OFAC sanctions screening, UN Security Council Consolidated List, and Samoa FIU domestic sanctions and refusal list; customer due diligence in line with FATF Recommendations; enhanced due diligence required for PEPs, foreign PEPs, and any person (or class of persons) flagged by the Samoa FIU.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Samoa International Companies Registry (SIRC), Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL) – online and in-person filing portal
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be in English or Roman script; non-English transliterations require a certified English translation; every International Company name must end with a legally recognised suffix such as 'Limited', 'Ltd', 'Corporation', 'Corp.', 'Inc.', or equivalent.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the chosen name is refused, the applicant may submit a written request for reconsideration to the Registrar of International Companies within 14 days of the refusal; if the Registrar upholds the rejection, the applicant may file an administrative appeal to the Minister of Commerce, Industry and Labour within 30 days of the Registrar's final decision. A name reservation may be extended once for a further 30 days upon payment of the prescribed extension fee prior to expiry.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A physically located registered office in Samoa is mandatory and must be maintained through a licensed registered agent; virtual office services may be used only for external operational correspondence and do not satisfy the statutory registered office requirement.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low to moderate – approximately 5–10% annual probability for low-risk manufacturing and trading entities; unannounced inspections may be conducted by the Registrar or the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit under the International Companies Act and AML/CFT regulations.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Government filing fee for incorporation (based on initial share capital)
Beneficial ownership filing and AML/CFT compliance pack
Consular legalisation and notarisation of UBO documents (per set)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Embassy/Consulate of Samoa and local notary authorities
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark and statutory consular fee

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 2015 (Samoa), ss. 7-16 (incorporation, memorandum and articles, certificate of incorporation), ss. 37-52 (directors and officers), ss. 64-72 (registered office and registered agent); International Companies Regulations 2015, regs. 3-8.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA), Apia, Samoa
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form 1 - Application for Incorporation of an International Company (pursuant to reg. 3 of the International Companies Regulations 2015) accompanied by the Memorandum and Articles of Association; resulting instrument: Certificate of Incorporation
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital and no escrow account requirement. Standard authorized capital is US$10,000 (up to US$1,000,000 permitted without enhanced fee). Shares may be allotted for cash or non-cash consideration at par or a premium as resolved by the Board.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED THAT the Company accept the Certificate of Incorporation issued by the Registrar of International Companies under the International Companies Act 2015, and that the registered office and registered agent be established at the licensed agent's office in Apia, Samoa. RESOLVED FURTHER THAT the subscriber shares be allotted to the founding subscriber; that [Name], [Name], and [Name] be appointed Directors; that [Name] be appointed Secretary; and that [Name] be appointed Managing Director, with authority to open bank accounts, execute contracts, hire employees, and adopt pre-incorporation contracts for the custom mechanical keyboard keycap business. RESOLVED FURTHER THAT the Company adopt 31 December as its financial year end and acknowledge tax-exempt status under the International Companies Act 2015.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, SIFA, acting through an SIFA-licensed Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit three proposed company names in order of preference on the approved Name Reservation Request form. Names must be distinguishable from existing registered names and must indicate limited status. Restricted words (bank, trust, insurance, assurance) are prohibited unless a separate sectoral license is held. The Registered Agent conducts the registry search and files the reservation electronically with the Registrar.
required_dossiers: Name Reservation Request signed by the proposed director
Certified copy of passport or valid government-issued ID of the proposed director/shareholder
Registered Agent engagement letter
Short due diligence questionnaire confirming non-resident ownership details
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused, the applicant may submit a revised request with alternate names within 21 days; no filing fee is forfeited when refusal is based on misleading similarity or prohibited words. A decision is deemed approved after 14 days absent a Notice of Query.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: SIFA-licensed Registered Agent (witnessing and notarization of subscriber signatures)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association under the International Companies Act 2015, including the standard objects clause authorizing all lawful business conducted outside Samoa. The subscriber executes the Memorandum and the first directors execute Consents to Act. Each signature page must be witnessed and dated; the Registered Agent verifies identity and retains certified copies for AML/CFT file purposes.
required_dossiers: Memorandum and Articles of Association (draft and executed)
Consent to Act as Director for each proposed director
Consent to Act as Secretary for the proposed company secretary
Certified copy of the subscriber's identity document
Certified copy of the subscriber resolution appointing the first directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct any typographical or clause inconsistencies and re-execute affected pages with a fresh date stamp. If the Registrar queries the objects clause, adopt the standard wording 'to engage in all lawful business outside Samoa' and resubmit the amended Memorandum.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Lodgment of Application with SIFA and Payment of Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, SIFA (electronic filing portal or counter lodgment at Apia)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File Form 1 - Application for Incorporation together with the executed Memorandum and Articles, Consents to Act, and the statutory declaration of compliance. Pay the official registration fee (approximately US$250 plus registered agent fees) via SIFA's approved payment channels. The applicant must confirm the company will carry on international business and maintain a registered office with a licensed agent in Samoa.
required_dossiers: Form 1 - Application for Incorporation
Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Consent to Act forms for all initial directors and the secretary
Statutory Declaration of Compliance by the applicant
Proof of payment of the registration fee
Copy of the Registered Agent's consent to act as registered office provider
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond to any Notice of Query within 14 days with corrected documents resubmitted through the Registered Agent. If the Registrar fails to issue a determination within 30 days, the applicant may appeal or request written reasons from the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon satisfactory review, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation bearing the company number and date of incorporation. The Memorandum and Articles are stamped, and the company comes into existence on the certificate date. The Registered Agent collects the certificate, produces certified true copies, and prepares the corporate kit containing the seal (if adopted), share certificates, registers, and minute book.
required_dossiers: Incorporation docket receipt from SIFA
SIFA company file number confirmation
Certified copy of the issued Certificate of Incorporation (for the company records)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate of Incorporation bears a clerical error, request immediate rectification under the International Companies Act 2015 without additional fee; obtain a replacement certificate sealed by the Registrar.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Governance and Corporate Kit Assembly
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors, with annual filing obligations to the SIFA Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting and adopt the pro-forma First Board Resolution covering allotment of subscriber shares, registered office confirmation, appointment of directors and officers, adoption of the financial year end, and acknowledgement of tax-exempt status. Open the statutory registers (members, directors, officers, charges). Request confirmation of Good Standing from the Registered Agent and, if required for banking, obtain a certified certificate of incumbency. International Companies are automatically exempt from Samoan income tax under the International Companies Act 2015 and must pay the annual government license fee when invoiced by SIFA.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation
First Board Resolution and minutes of the first board meeting
Share certificates and register of members
Register of directors, officers, and charges
Registered Agent confirmation of registered office
Certificate of incumbency (for bank onboarding if requested)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the annual license fee remains unpaid, pay the amount plus late penalty within the prescribed reinstatement window to preserve Good Standing; if the company is struck off, file a restoration application with the Registrar and pay all arrears to revive the company.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL) - no industrial license, business license, or factory registration is required for an International Company manufacturing custom keycaps outside Samoa; such licensing applies only if a physical production facility is established on Samoan territory.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Business Licence under the Business Licences Act 1998 and Factory Registration Certificate under the Labour and Employment Act 2013 (conditional solely upon establishment of a domestic manufacturing facility)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Division of Environment and Conservation (DEC), Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE), Samoa
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Not triggered for an offshore-operating International Company. If a plastic injection facility with resin throughput equal to or above 0.5 tonnes per day is established in Samoa, the project is classified as Category 2 - Preliminary Environmental Report under the Planning and Urban Management Act 2004; a full Environmental Impact Assessment is required only for sites in environmentally sensitive or coastal-protected zones.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: If a domestic facility is ever established: wastewater discharge must meet Samoa National Effluent Quality Standards (pH 6.5-8.5, BOD5 not exceeding 30 mg/L, TSS not exceeding 50 mg/L, oils and grease not exceeding 10 mg/L); air emissions must not cause detectable odor beyond the site boundary and 24-hour PM10 must not exceed 50 ug/m3; waste polymer and sprue scrap must be recycled or disposed of under the Waste Management Regulations. Export-only keycap production ordinarily involves no treated discharge to Samoan waters.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Conditional on a Samoan facility only: fire safety certificate from the Samoa Fire and Emergency Services Authority (SFESA); building occupancy and structural load certification by a registered engineer under the Building Code of Samoa (Planning and Urban Management Act 2004); occupational safety and health clearance under the Labour and Employment Act 2013 covering machine guarding, lock-out/tag-out procedures for injection presses, ventilation for plastic resin dust, and safe storage of polymer pellets and colorants; no dangerous-goods permit is triggered unless stored solvents or monomer gases exceed threshold quantities.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Samoa Ministry for Revenue (MfR), Apia, Samoa — online portal: https://www.mfr.gov.ws — a unified revenue authority administering income tax, VAGST and customs under one taxpayer registration record. International Company (IC) incorporation and annual registry compliance are separately administered by the International Companies Registry at the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), https://www.mcil.gov.ws. Exchange control over export proceeds is administered by the Central Bank of Samoa (CBS).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: (1) The Samoa IC is incorporated with MCIL through a licensed Samoan registered agent; there is no minimum capital requirement and non-resident ownership is unrestricted. (2) A Samoa IC operating exclusively offshore is statutorily exempt under Section 192 of the International Companies Act 1987 (ICA) and has no obligation to obtain a TIN; where banks or commercial counterparties require tax identification, the IC may apply to MfR for a formal tax-exemption confirmation letter, supported by the certificate of incorporation, register of directors and members, registered-agent certificate, and a statutory declaration that no business is carried on in Samoa. (3) Only if the IC makes taxable supplies in Samoa, imports goods for domestic consumption, or employs staff in Samoa must it file Form TIN-01 with MfR Taxpayer Services in Apia, either in person or through a notarised tax agent under a general power of attorney, attaching passport copies, the incorporation certificate, and the registered-office certificate; TIN issuance takes approximately 5 business days and a VAGST registration certificate up to 10 business days. (4) A TIN, once issued, is permanent and must appear on all Samoan tax invoices, customs declarations and VAT returns.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone. The Samoa IC is an entity-level offshore exempt company: under ICA 1987 s.192, no Samoan income tax (standard corporate rate 27%), no capital gains tax, no stamp duty, no transfer duty, and no withholding tax on dividends, interest, royalties or distributions applies to the IC's income, profits, gains, distributions, or to dealings in its shares, debentures or marketable securities, provided the IC does not carry on business in Samoa and does not transact with Samoan residents. Distributions to shareholders are equally exempt. The exemption is permanent and entity-level, not a pass-through election. The IC cannot access Samoan foreign tax credits or bilateral treaty relief unless the Minister of Finance issues a discretionary declaration under ICA 1987 s.192(3), the anti-treaty-shopping rule.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Samoa does not maintain a US-style check-the-box regime and has no hybrid-mismatch or CFC elections for International Companies. Available statutory mechanisms: (1) ICA 1987 s.192(3) Ministerial declaration — the Minister of Finance may, by notice, declare an IC to be resident for the purposes of a double tax agreement, thereby exposing the IC to Samoan income tax only on Samoan-source income; the IC cannot self-elect into or out of this status. (2) Voluntary VAGST registration under the VAGST Act 2013 s.8(3), available with MfR approval only to persons making taxable supplies in Samoa; a wholly offshore IC has no taxable supplies and is not registrable. (3) Remission of penalties by the Commissioner for reasonable-cause non-compliance under the applicable Tax Administration legislation. There is no election to convert an IC into an ordinary taxable Samoan company, no group consolidation election, and no hybrid-finance or hybrid-entity election.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (Faletupe Tutotonu o Samoa), licensed banking supervisor and administrator of the Exchange Control Act 1976 and Exchange Control Regulations 1977; the Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) separately supervises international companies, licensed registered agents, and international-company AML/CFT compliance under the International Companies Act 1987 (as amended).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Samoan Tala (WST) is freely convertible on current-account transactions under Samoa's IMF Article VIII status (accepted 1999); domestic capital-account transfers require Central Bank of Samoa approval through authorised banks. Samoa International Companies are statutorily excluded from the Exchange Control Act 1976, so the IC may freely hold, convert, and remit USD, CNH, and WST without CBS approval or profit-remittance licensing. Practical remittance hurdles are non-statutory: no Stripe or Shopify Payments payout market in Samoa, correspondent-bank de-risking of the WST corridor, and a narrow cleared-bank network (principally BSP and Bank of Samoa). No Samoan withholding tax, dividend tax, or capital-gains tax applies to a non-resident shareholder of an IC on repatriated profits.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: For resident trading companies, CBS exchange-control policy requires export proceeds to be repatriated within 180 days of shipment and, where converted, surrendered through the licensed banking system at the prevailing interbank rate. International Companies are outside the statutory exchange-control regime, so no mandatory surrender ratio or repatriation deadline applies to the IC's keyboard-keycap export receipts; USD and CNH balances may be held offshore without obligation to convert to WST. If the IC clears earnings through a domestic WST account, the CBS normal-dealing rule and bank customer-dealing rates apply to any conversion.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of Samoa Ltd (successor to ANZ Samoa; government-controlled, Apia)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational USD and WST settlement account; no trade-desk LC capability
Operational WST account; limited USD and no international trade services

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of South Pacific (BSP) Samoa Limited (successor to Westpac Samoa; BSP Group)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: USD/WST operational account, MT103 priority payments, and commercial LC desk under UCP600

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low direct viability. Mainstream offshore EMIs (Airwallex, Dukascopy, Mercury, Currencycloud) routinely decline Samoa-incorporated entities because of Samoa's offshore-centre profile, its historic FATF increased-monitoring listing (removed 2021), and current EU Code of Conduct Group Annex II observation. Legal constraints: a Samoa IC cannot hold an EMI licence and cannot open an e-money account without a bank reference, a SIFA-licensed registered agent's attestation, and a full UBO documentation pack; the EMI must satisfy the e-money and AML/CFT rules of its home jurisdiction. Viable alternative: retain the Samoa IC as trading and IP principal while routing receivables settlement through a supported-jurisdiction intermediary, or use the BSP treasury network as a directly sponsored channel.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Samoa's AML/CFT Act 2007 (as amended) and CBS directives do not mandate physical board appearance; remote onboarding is legally permissible on the basis of notarised or certified IDs, certified constitutional documents, a professional bank reference, and a SIFA-licensed registered agent's compliance attestation, supplemented by live video verification. In practice, BSP Samoa and Bank of Samoa require at least one authorised signatory (typically the sole director) or the registered agent's compliance officer to attend an in-person or live video interview with the local compliance team before account activation for a non-resident-owned IC. Budget three to six weeks for account opening and two-step banker's verification for any additional signatory.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore tax-exempt IC with nominee directors or shareholders and opaque ownership (classic shell profile) triggering FATF and EU shell-company red flags at onboarding utility.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of Incorporation, Certificate of Good Standing, updated Memorandum and Articles, shareholders register, beneficial-ownership register held by the SIFA-licensed registered agent, UBO passport copies and signed declaration, corporate organisation chart, and a substance summary evidencing active trading under ISIC 3240 and NAICS 334118.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unclear source of funds for the initial capital injection (typically USD 5,000 to 50,000) and for subsequent e-commerce receipts from Shopify Payments and Stripe markets in the US and EU.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Six-month shareholder bank statements, executed subscription agreement and board resolution, inbound MT103 narrative 'CAPITAL CONTRIBUTION', Shopify and Stripe merchant verification files, monthly payout statements, customer invoice and payment reconciliation, and a signed source-of-wealth declaration.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions-screening hits on Chinese injection-moulding suppliers, PBT resin vendors, or cross-border resellers creating U.N., OFAC, EU, or UK consolidated-list matches.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Automated screening reports for all KYC counterparties, supplier licensing and business-registration files, export-licence and HS-code documentation (HS 8471.60 and 3926.90), end-user declarations, and contractual no-sanctioned-reexport warranties.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Velocity-and-volume anomalies from B2C e-commerce (high-frequency, low-value, multi-currency payouts) mischaracterised as trade-based money laundering through online marketplaces.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Business-model memorandum on double-shot PBT keycap production and fulfilment, Shopify storefront read-only access, monthly order-shipping-refund reconciliations, supplier purchase orders and customs records, and a registered-agent letter confirming the IC's active trading status.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Route shareholder capital by SWIFT MT103 to the IC's USD treasury account (BSP Samoa or an approved offshore settlement bank) using beneficiary name WS_IC, registered-address line, and field 70 purpose code 'CAPITAL CONTRIBUTION - WS__WS__WS_IC__ISIC_3240_06_CUSTOM_MECHANICAL_KEYBOARD_CAPS'. No CBS exchange-control certificate is required for the IC, but the receiving bank will request its foreign-remittance questionnaire, subscription and receipt evidence, and the registered agent's confirmation before crediting. For sales proceeds, Stripe and Shopify Payments do not support Samoa as a payout market; settlement must be received in USD in a supported jurisdiction and swept via MT103 or SEPA to the IC treasury account, with the processor's payout statements retained as source-of-funds evidence.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary clearing rails: (i) SWIFT MT103 priority payments (same-day or next-day value) for supplier prepayments and trade payables under USD 100,000, including USD/CNH conversion to Chinese injection-moulding plants and PBT resin vendors; (ii) irrevocable sight commercial letters of credit under UCP600, issued through BSP Samoa's trade desk for large tooling or bulk-resin commitments; (iii) the settlement processor's ACH or SEPA rails for refunds and Shopify or Stripe reserve movements; and (iv) domestic WST transfers for registered-agent and legal fees. Every disbursement must reference the underlying purchase order and be matched to the IC's invoice register to preserve the trade-based AML defence.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/CNH non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) with a licensed regional trade bank to hedge CNY-denominated supplier costs without onshore CNY access
USD/WST deliverable forwards booked through BSP Samoa or Bank of Samoa for contractual conversion of local operating expenses
USD/CNY cross-currency swaps (CCS) with a bank counterparty for long-dated working-capital funding of the China manufacturing relationship
USD interest-rate and currency-basis swaps via the settlement bank treasury desk, permissible for the IC without CBS approval by virtue of the exchange-control exemption

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return and Annual License Fee (International Company)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary of incorporation date (within 30 days after anniversary)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late penalty of USD 100 or 10% of annual fee per month (whichever greater); administrative strike-off after 3 months of continued non-payment

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before the anniversary date of the international company's registration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Registered agent may resign after 30 days' notice; failure to maintain agent triggers strike-off

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit required for Samoa International Companies unless mandated by shareholders' resolution, a court order, or a directive from SIFA; an audit may also be required by a banking institution for financing.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS or Samoa Equivalent GAAP as adopted by the Ministry of Revenue; financial statements are not required to be filed unless an audit is triggered.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: A annual beneficial ownership confirmation must be filed with the registered agent, updating any changes in shareholding or beneficial ownership from the prior year; this is confidential and not publicly inspectable.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: 500-1,200 USD per annum depending on provider and compliance volume
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: 1,500-4,000 USD per engagement (voluntary or triggered audit)

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 27% (standard resident company rate, Income Tax Act 2012); International Companies (ICs) carrying on exclusively offshore business are statutorily exempt from all Samoan income tax, yielding a 0% effective rate.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: S.184 International Companies Act 2004 exempts the IC from income tax, capital gains tax, stamp duty, gift duty, estate duty, and all withholding taxes on dividends, interest, royalties, and other payments. No VAGST (value added goods and services tax) applies to offshore IC activity. The only recurring fiscal charge is the annual SIFA government fee, scaled to authorized capital (approximately USD 100 minimum; no minimum paid-up capital requirement).

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual Return and Renewal of International Company Registration (Part X, International Companies Act 2004); lodged electronically by the SIFA-licensed registered agent via the Samoa International Financial Authority (SIFA) corporate portal. No corporate income tax return is filed with the Ministry of Revenue while the IC tax exemption applies.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due on or before each anniversary of incorporation; the annual government fee must accompany the return. A 30-day administrative grace period applies before default surcharges accrue.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 1 - Company Name and Registration Number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name of the IC as stated in the Memorandum of Association and the unique registration number issued by the Registrar of International Companies.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include the 'Limited' suffix; English name only. Any name change requires prior SIFA approval.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical street address of the registered office in Apia maintained by the licensed registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: This is the agent's address, not a place of business. It must not be used as a local warehouse, fulfilment centre, or sales office for custom keycaps.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Identity and licence number of the SIFA-licensed registered agent responsible for statutory filings and fee payment.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Agent retention is mandatory at all times; termination triggers automatic administrative suspension.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full names, residential addresses, and passport details of each director; minimum one individual director; corporate directors are prohibited.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors are permitted. Nominee directors are permissible but expose the appointee to personal liability under AML and tax statutes.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorized share capital, share classes, and par value; no minimum paid-up capital is required.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The authorized capital tier determines the annual government fee; capital may be expressed in USD or WST.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Description of the offshore business (e-commerce manufacture and distribution of custom mechanical keyboard keycaps) and confirmation that no business is carried on in Samoa.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The IC must not solicit Samoan customers, hold stock in Samoa, or execute sales agreements in Samoa. Shopify Payments and Stripe merchant accounts must be linked to the offshore structure.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Ultimate beneficial owner details maintained in the central beneficial ownership register under Samoa's AML/CFT and CRS/AEOI frameworks.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Beneficial owners resident in treaty jurisdictions must provide tax identification numbers and, where applicable, foreign tax resident certificates; omissions trigger CRS information exchange to the owner's home revenue authority.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing attracts a fixed statutory fine plus a 10% surcharge on the unpaid annual government fee. Persistent default beyond three months results in administrative strike-off; reinstatement requires a court order, payment of all arrears, and a restoration fee. Knowingly false declarations are punishable by fines up to WST 100,000 and imprisonment up to five years.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Nil Corporate Income Tax Position (Ministry of Revenue, Tax Administration Act 2012). An exempt IC holds no Samoan CIT filing obligation, no provisional tax requirement, and no payroll tax registration while the exemption under s.184 International Companies Act 2004 remains in force.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Not applicable for an exempt IC; annual CIT filing becomes mandatory only if the IC loses its exemption or carries on business in Samoa.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: No CIT deadline applies to the exempt entity. TIN registration with the Ministry of Revenue becomes mandatory within 14 days of commencing any Samoan-source commercial activity.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Self-executing statutory confirmation that the IC is outside the Samoan income tax base; no taxable income is computed for offshore IC operations.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Maintain board resolutions, intercompany manufacturing agreements, and transaction-flow records evidencing the offshore character of the keycap business.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Determination of the IC's place of effective management for CRS, AEOI, and the beneficial owner's domestic CFC/attribution rules.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Board meetings, contract execution, and bank signatory decisions should occur outside Samoa and outside the owner's residence country where the owner's jurisdiction applies CFC or managed-company attribution rules (e.g., US, Australia, New Zealand).

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to notify the Ministry of Revenue upon commencing local activity subjects the IC to CIT at 27% on Samoan-source income, back-dated assessments up to four years, late-payment penalties of 10%, and evasion penalties of up to 150% of any tax shortfall.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 15% (statutory rate on Samoan-source dividends paid to non-residents, Income Tax Act 2012); 0% for dividends and capital distributions paid by an International Company by operation of the s.184 exemption.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: No treaty relief is required for IC distributions because IC dividends are already zero-rated. For payments sourced from a Samoan resident company, the beneficial owner must: (1) obtain a Samoa Tax Resident Certificate from the Ministry of Revenue (for the payer) and a Tax Resident Certificate (TRC) from its own jurisdiction; (2) submit the TRC plus a CRS/W-8 self-certification to the Samoan withholding agent before payment; (3) apply the relevant DTA article. Samoa's primary income tax treaties are with Australia, New Zealand, and Norway, which cap dividends at 15%, interest at 10%, and royalties at 10%. Samoa's AEOI/CRS network requires substantive ownership and tax residence evidence; treaty-shopping structures without economic substance will be denied relief.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory Samoa WHT: interest 15%, royalties 15% (Income Tax Act 2012). DTA-reduced rates under the Australia, New Zealand, and Norway treaties: interest 10%, royalties 10%. An International Company is exempt from WHT on both inbound and outbound interest and royalty flows; however, royalties paid by the IC for keycap design IP or moulding software to a related non-resident licensor must still comply with the arm's length principle and CRS/CFC transparency expectations.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable - Samoa has not enacted Local File/Master File transfer pricing legislation. The Commissioner of Inland Revenue applies the arm's length principle through the general anti-avoidance provisions of the Income Tax Act 2012; no WST-denominated documentation threshold exists. As prudent governance, ICs with related-party manufacturing or IP flows exceeding the equivalent of WST 1,000,000 in annual turnover should maintain contemporaneous OECD-style TP documentation and executed intercompany agreements in English.
